_source: MapEditor\MapEditor.cs, Cursor.cs, TilePalette.cs, Tileset.cs and Tile.cs (RECONSTRUCTION 8, 12), in the original's screen and map pixels, y down. The camera's mouse scroll (2) and cell scroll (4) are camera.json's editorScrollSteps; a cleared cell is grid.json's fresh cell. BIBLE defects 9 and 10 are fixed in code: the palette draws each tile once at its place, the pick and the arrow steps stay on the sheet, and nothing is painted or highlighted outside the grid.

cursor._about: Cursor("cursor", ...): cursor_hand_topleft, 13 x 18, drawn with its top-left at Position. World mode: the mouse more than deadZone / 2 from the screen centre scrolls the camera, and Position is the view's centre plus half the picture (whole pixels). Colour: left button, else right button, else neither.

palette._about: TilePalette: GuiItem("tilepalette_background", g.Alpha(0.4f), (5, H - 305, 300, 295)), the tileset at Offset (16, 300) with every Tile's colour (255, 255, 255, 128), and square_selector at Offset + SelectedTile * 16 in white.
